items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: There was a little jealousy on Tommy and I side, I guess it was.

ctx.x: Jimmy was a sweetheart. I loved it. There was a little jealousy on Tommy and I side, I guess it was. And he played seven choruses on a trombone, with variations and all that tongue and everything. And he hit a high cadenza on the finish with a high F without breathing, taking a breath. Well, I do one thing now and the same. Do-do-do-do-do-do-do-do. But I can only do it for one chorus. Yeah, that's good. But he, oh, this, this, this man was fabulous for breathing control. Uh, but Jimmy was a doll. I mean, I love…
Did, uh, did you ever actually practice by yourself, get the thing and try to learn? Never warm up. Never warm up.
